name: Booking.com
note: The legal page identifies Booking.com B.V. in Amsterdam, Netherlands, as the operator of its online accommodation reservation service.

name: Expedia
note: The group identifies Expedia as its consumer service for online booking of flights, accommodation, car hire and cruises.

name: Hotels.com
note: The group identifies Hotels.com as its consumer hotel booking service.

name: Trip.com
note: The terms identify Trip.com Travel Singapore Pte. Ltd. at its Singapore address as the licensed online travel agency operating the service. This distinguishes the operator from the Chinese parent group.

name: MakeMyTrip
note: The legal page identifies the Gurugram, India operator and its online intermediation of travel and accommodation services.

name: Viator
note: Viator describes its marketplace for travel experiences and the booking of tours and activities.

name: Traveloka
note: Traveloka describes its platform for searching and booking flights, hotels and experiences. Country is resolved separately from the published headquarters claim, not its markets or founding story.

name: eDreams
note: The terms identify Vacaciones eDreams S.L., incorporated in Spain with a Madrid registered office, as the operator. This takes precedence over Wikidata's conflicting US country claim.

name: Kiwi.com
note: The company's media page describes Kiwi.com as both an online travel agency and a travel technology company; the current company domain replaces the historical Skypicker URL in Wikidata.
